# Need a hand?


Tumult Hype is a powerful tool for creating HTML5 animations. To get up to speed with Tumult Hype, we recommend checking out the[documentation](http://tumult.com/hype/documentation/) &[tutorials](http://tumult.com/hype/tutorials/) or viewing our[introductory videos](http://j.mp/16NLXSW) . We also share a number of animations on in our[gallery](http://tumult.com/hype/gallery) that you can download and explore.
